resources.string: Open Lom on your computer, choose Add phone, then scan its pairing QR code.
Enter the 8-character code shown on your computer. You will confirm the computer before connecting.
Check that this code matches the one on your computer.
This phone has joined your Lom account and now appears on your computer.
Pairing service is not connected yet. Please try again after the service adapter is configured.
This is not a valid Lom pairing QR code.
Pairing code is not correct. Enter the 8 characters shown on your computer (no 0, O, 1, I or L).
This code has expired. Refresh it on your computer.
Camera access is unavailable. Allow access in system settings, or use a pairing code.
Pairing information does not match. Scan a new code.
This pairing code has already been used. Refresh it on your computer.
Too many attempts. Please try again later.
Cannot reach the pairing service. Check your connection.
This phone belongs to another account. Unpair it first.
Pairing could not be completed. Please try again.
Pairing information is incomplete. Cancel and refresh the code on your computer.
Pairing check failed. Refresh the QR code on your computer and try again.
The computer cancelled this pairing. Refresh it on your computer.
The computer has not finished checking yet. Keep the Add phone window open on your computer and try again.
Could not save the connection. Tap Confirm connection again.
This phone is already connected. Unpair it first to connect another computer.
This phone cannot create secure keys, so it cannot pair right now.
The computer will no longer be able to direct this phone. Sessions, skills, persona and memory stay on the phone.
